# REDHAT-FIX-02 — Bounded/paginated whole-catalog classifyCatalog enumeration with durable checkpointing and completion coverage (UC-VER-03)
> Status: ⬜ Pending

| Field | Value |

| TASK_ID | REDHAT-FIX-02 |
| SPRINT | [Sprint 04 — Trust pipeline](./SPRINT.md) |
| TASK_TYPE | FEATURE |

| ESTIMATE | 120 min |

| PRIORITY | P0 |
| STATUS | Backlog |

| TDD_MODE | `red_first` |
| RED_GREEN_REQUIRED | yes |
| CAPABILITIES | CAP-GEO-03 |
| DEPENDS_ON | — |
| BLOCKS | REDHAT-FIX-01 |

RUNTIME_COMMANDS:
- test: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX02-*.integration.test.ts`
- typecheck: `npx tsc --noEmit -p convex/tsconfig.json`
- lint: `pnpm exec biome check`

> **Command note:** `pnpm test` maps to bare `vitest` (watch mode) and HANGS in an agent shell — always use `npx vitest run`. vitest has no `--grep`; the single-test filter is `-t '<name>'`.

## OUTCOME

Whole-catalog classification with no `routeIds` visits every catalog route exactly once across bounded, indexed pages, stores a rideWorthiness verdict per route, and leaves a durable `classifier_runs` checkpoint whose `classifiedCount+failedCount` equals `totalRoutes` on completion — resumable after interruption.

## 🚫 CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS (Never tier — read before acting)

**MUST**
- MUST read convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md before implementation
- MUST enumerate every `curated_routes` row via an indexed paginated query (`db.query(...).paginate`) — never a single unbounded `.collect()` over the whole table
- MUST persist a durable checkpoint row (cursor + coverage totals) between action invocations so an interrupted run resumes without reclassifying completed routes
- MUST report `classifiedCount` + `failedCount` + `totalRoutes` so completion coverage over the whole catalog is observable evidence

**NEVER**
- NEVER return `{classified:0,failed:0,results:[]}` as a silent no-op when `routeIds` is omitted (the current line-264 behavior)
- NEVER require the caller to pass every routeId to achieve whole-catalog coverage
- NEVER load the entire catalog into one query result or one action invocation
- NEVER classify a route twice across a resumed run

**STRICTLY**
- STRICTLY additive schema change only — add a new `classifier_runs` checkpoint table; do not mutate existing table shapes non-additively
- STRICTLY page continuation is server-driven (`scheduler.runAfter` of an internalAction), not caller-driven

## DONE WHEN

- AC-1 [Whole-catalog classification with no routeIds achieves complete coverage] [PRIMARY]: Every route in a 5-route, 3-page catalog ends with a stored verdict and `classifiedCount+failedCount == totalRoutes == 5`
- AC-2 [Durable checkpoint resumes from cursor without reclassifying]: Resuming from a page-1 checkpoint classifies only the remaining routes without re-touching already-classified ones
- AC-3 [Per-invocation pagination is bounded]: A single `classifyCatalogPage` invocation processes at most `pageSize` routes and schedules a continuation
- AC-4 [classifyCatalog no longer silently no-ops on empty routeIds]: Calling with no `routeIds` creates a real `classifier_runs` row reflecting the catalog size
- Every behavioral AC scenario passes `validate_scenario` (exit 0); RED-against-start recorded before GREEN; seeded-value EVIDENCE artifact captured
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p convex/tsconfig.json` → 0 errors + `pnpm exec biome check` clean + `pnpm convex:dev --once` clean
- NO-REGRESSION: `pnpm type-check` reports zero new errors vs. a baseline captured at task start
- Only SCOPE.writeAllowed files modified (`git diff --name-only`)

## SPECIFICATION

**Objective:** Replace the caller-ID-dependent silent no-op in `classifyCatalog` with a server-driven, bounded, indexed-paginated enumeration of the entire `curated_routes` catalog that durably checkpoints its cursor and coverage totals and is resumable after interruption.

**Success state:** Calling whole-catalog classification with no `routeIds` visits every catalog route exactly once across bounded pages, stores a rideWorthiness verdict per route, and leaves a durable `classifier_runs` row whose `classifiedCount+failedCount` equals `totalRoutes` on completion.

## FIXTURES (shared seed data — referenced by scenario `start_ref`)

- `multi-page-catalog` (seed_method: `public_api`): 5 curated_routes seeded with no rideWorthiness verdict, so a small pageSize (2) forces 3 pages and pagination/continuation is exercised end-to-end
    - routeId: `test:catalog-cov-1`..`test:catalog-cov-5`, rideWorthiness undefined — seeded via new helper `seedUnclassifiedCatalogRoutes` in `convex/curatedGeometryTestSupport.ts`
- `catalog-classifier-cassette` (seed_method: `recorded_external`): z.ai GLM-5.2 classifier request/response pairs recorded ONCE from the real provider for the 5 seeded routes, replayed byte-exact so enumeration/coverage is deterministic without mocking the LLM (mirrors S4-T1 AC-5)
    - cassette: `convex/__tests__/fixtures/REDHATFIX02-catalog-classifier.cassette.json`
- `partial-run-checkpoint` (seed_method: `public_api`): A `classifier_runs` row left after page 1 completed (cursor past the first 2 routes, classifiedCount=2)
    - `classifier_runs` doc: `{ runId, status:'running', cursor: <after page 1>, pageSize:2, totalRoutes:5, classifiedCount:2, failedCount:0 }` — new helper `seedClassifierCheckpoint`

## ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (TDD beads — RED → GREEN → REFACTOR per AC)

### AC-1 [PRIMARY] — Whole-catalog classification with no routeIds achieves complete coverage

**Requirement:** GIVEN a catalog of 5 unclassified curated_routes spanning >1 page (pageSize=2) and a caller that passes NO routeIds WHEN whole-catalog classification is started and run to completion via server-driven page continuation THEN every one of the 5 routes has a stored rideWorthiness verdict and the final classifier_runs row reports classifiedCount+failedCount == totalRoutes == 5 with status 'complete'

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment + z.ai GLM-5.2 (recorded cassette)
- FLOW_REF: UC-VER-03
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX02-whole-catalog-coverage.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: `classifyCatalog` returns a stub `{classified:0,failed:0}` for omitted routeIds; only the first page is classified and routes 3-5 keep an undefined rideWorthiness; the LLM boundary is mocked instead of replayed from the recorded cassette
- EVIDENCE: `db_query` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `multi-page-catalog`
  - ACTION: Seed 5 unclassified catalog routes; start whole-catalog classification with NO routeIds (pageSize=2, cassette replay enabled); drive all scheduled continuation pages to completion; query every seeded route's rideWorthiness and the classifier_runs row
  - MUST_OBSERVE: `classifier_runs.totalRoutes == 5`; `classifier_runs.classifiedCount + classifier_runs.failedCount == 5`; `classifier_runs.status == 'complete'`
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: any of the 5 routes with rideWorthiness undefined after completion (empty); `classifier_runs.classifiedCount == 0`

### AC-2 — Durable checkpoint resumes from cursor without reclassifying

**Requirement:** GIVEN a classifier_runs checkpoint whose cursor is past page 1 (routes 1-2 already classified, classifiedCount=2) WHEN classification resumes for the same runId THEN it continues from the stored cursor, classifies only routes 3-5, and finishes with classifiedCount+failedCount==5 while routes 1-2 are not classified a second time

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment (real classifier_runs cursor)
- FLOW_REF: UC-VER-03
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX02-checkpoint-resume.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: resume restarts enumeration from the beginning (a stub cursor) and re-classifies routes 1-2; the cursor is not persisted (empty) and resume double-counts
- EVIDENCE: `db_query` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `partial-run-checkpoint`
  - ACTION: Seed multi-page-catalog and a partial-run-checkpoint after page 1; capture the classifiedAt timestamps of routes 1-2 before resume; resume classification for the checkpoint runId to completion; re-query routes 1-2 classifiedAt and the final checkpoint totals
  - MUST_OBSERVE: classifiedAt(route1) after resume == classifiedAt(route1) before resume; final classifier_runs.classifiedCount + failedCount == 5
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: classifiedCount+failedCount != 5 (partial coverage); route1 classifiedAt reset to empty/null on resume

### AC-3 — Per-invocation pagination is bounded

**Requirement:** GIVEN a catalog larger than one page (5 routes, pageSize=2) WHEN a single classifyCatalogPage invocation runs THEN it processes at most pageSize (2) routes, sets a continuation cursor, and schedules the next page rather than draining the whole catalog in one invocation

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment (real paginate boundary)
- FLOW_REF: UC-VER-03
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX02-page-bounded.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: a single invocation classifies all 5 routes via an unbounded/mocked full-collect scan; no continuation cursor is written (empty) after the first page
- EVIDENCE: `db_query` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `multi-page-catalog`
  - ACTION: Seed 5 unclassified routes (pageSize=2); invoke exactly ONE classifyCatalogPage for a fresh runId; inspect the checkpoint after the single page
  - MUST_OBSERVE: classified count after one page == 2; classifier_runs.isDone == false
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: classified count after one page == 5; classifier_runs.cursor is empty while routes remain

### AC-4 — classifyCatalog no longer silently no-ops on empty routeIds

**Requirement:** GIVEN classifyCatalog invoked with no routeIds (omitted or empty array) WHEN the action runs THEN it initiates whole-catalog enumeration and returns a runId/coverage plan reflecting the real catalog size — never {classified:0,failed:0,results:[]} with zero work

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment
- FLOW_REF: UC-VER-03
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX02-no-silent-noop.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: classifyCatalog with no routeIds returns a static stub {classified:0,failed:0,results:[]}; no classifier_runs row is created (absent)
- EVIDENCE: `db_query` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `multi-page-catalog`
  - ACTION: Seed 5 unclassified routes; call whole-catalog classification with NO routeIds argument; inspect the returned runId and the created classifier_runs row
  - MUST_OBSERVE: classifier_runs.totalRoutes == 5
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: totalRoutes == 0 while the catalog holds 5 rows; no classifier_runs row created (absent)

## OUTCOME

A couch PASS can only be recorded by an operator against the current sample's server-computed manifest hash with a complete exact-membership decision set; the verdict is appended (never replaced); `couchGateStatus.allowed` is true only for the current active manifest.

## 🚫 CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS (Never tier — read before acting)

**MUST**
- MUST read convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md before implementation
- MUST load the stored couch_samples row for the submitted sampleId and reject (fail-closed) when it is absent
- MUST compute a server-derived manifest hash from the exact stored sample contents and require the submitted verdict to carry that same hash — reject on mismatch
- MUST require exact per-route membership: every sample route has exactly one decision, no missing routes, no extras, no duplicate routeIds
- MUST require an operator/founder identity via REDHAT-FIX-06's `requireOperator(ctx)` primitive and record that identity on the verdict
- MUST record verdicts append-only (audit trail) with per-route decisions + notes — never `ctx.db.replace` over a prior verdict

**NEVER**
- NEVER accept an arbitrary sampleId + routeVerdicts blob with no stored-sample validation (current couchVerdict.ts:51-101 behavior)
- NEVER let couchGateStatus report allowed=true from ANY historical pass row unbound to the current sample manifest (current :128-155 behavior)
- NEVER allow a non-operator authenticated caller to record a couch verdict

`recordCouchVerdict` rejects any `routeVerdicts` that don't exactly cover the stored sample; `couchGateStatus`/`runAllWaterfall` unlock `--all` only from an operator-recorded pass bound to the current sample's manifest hash; a re-exported sample re-blocks `--all` until re-approved.

## 🚫 CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS (Never tier — read before acting)

**MUST**
- MUST read convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md before implementation
- MUST load the stored couch_samples row for sampleId and reject recordCouchVerdict unless routeVerdicts is an exact unique membership match (set equality on routeId AND equal length AND no duplicate routeIds)
- MUST persist the sample's manifestHash (REDHAT-FIX-03) onto the couch_verdicts row and bind couchGateStatus.allowed / runAllWaterfall to the CURRENT sample's manifestHash, not any historical pass
- MUST require requireOperator(ctx) (REDHAT-FIX-06) on recordCouchVerdict and on the --all gate entry points (couchGateStatus/runAllWaterfall)

**NEVER**
- NEVER accept an arbitrary nonempty routeVerdicts array for a sampleId with no stored sample validation (the current recordCouchVerdict behavior)
- NEVER return allowed=true from couchGateStatus based on any historical pass row whose manifestHash differs from the current sample's
- NEVER let a duplicate routeId in routeVerdicts satisfy membership

**STRICTLY**
- STRICTLY membership is exact set equality plus length equality plus no-duplicates against couch_samples.routes
- STRICTLY a re-exported sample (new manifestHash) invalidates prior verdicts for --all until a fresh pass is recorded against the new manifest

- AC-3 [A re-exported sample re-blocks --all until re-approved]: A pass on H1 does not unlock once the sample is re-exported to H2
- AC-4 [Non-operator cannot record a couch verdict]: A non-operator recordCouchVerdict call throws FORBIDDEN

## OUTCOME

`approveDisposition` decodes the actual candidate geometry, re-measures it, and re-runs the canonical region-aware gate — only a genuinely passing verdict sets `riderReady`/`generated`; failing candidates stay in REVIEW; provenance is never overwritten with a hardcoded value.

## 🚫 CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS (Never tier — read before acting)

**MUST**
- MUST read convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md before implementation
- MUST re-measure pointCount and routedMiles by decoding the actual stored candidate polyline (`@mapbox/polyline` decode + `haversineDistance` from curatedGeometryGate.ts), never by copying `geom.verification.pointCount`/`routedMiles` or defaulting anchorCount ?? 2 / ratio ?? 1.0
- MUST call the canonical region-aware gate (`reevaluateExistingGeometry` / `determineGateVerdict` as corrected by REDHAT-FIX-07) and derive verdict, riderReady, and geometryStatus solely from its return value
- MUST call `requireOperator(ctx)` (REDHAT-FIX-06) at the start of approveDisposition

**NEVER**
- NEVER stamp verdict:'pass', riderReady:true, or geometryStatus:'generated' without a genuine passing gate verdict on the re-measured geometry
- NEVER hardcode provenance to 'scraped_promoted' — persist the candidate's actual provenance
- NEVER leave a failing candidate approved-and-servable: a failing re-gate must keep geometryStatus='review' and riderReady=false

**STRICTLY**
- STRICTLY the persisted verification.verdict/failedCondition/ratio/ratioSkipped equal the canonical gate's return for the decoded geometry
- STRICTLY rider-ready is admitted only via a passing verdict (CAP-GEO-03)

## DONE WHEN

- AC-1 [Approving a route whose real candidate geometry fails the gate keeps it in REVIEW and never sets rider-ready] [PRIMARY]: A 3-point candidate stays geometryStatus='review', riderReady=false, failedCondition='degenerate'
- AC-2 [Approving a route whose real candidate geometry passes promotes it to rider-ready]: A genuinely passing candidate becomes geometryStatus='generated', riderReady=true, verdict='pass'
- AC-3 [Actual provenance is preserved, not overwritten with scraped_promoted]: ai_reconstructed provenance is preserved, never hardcoded
- AC-4 [Off-region anchors block approval, and non-operators cannot approve]: Off-region anchors keep the route in REVIEW; a non-operator call throws FORBIDDEN

## SPECIFICATION

**Objective:** Replace the forged-pass `approveDisposition` (which copies/defaults measurements, stamps `verdict:'pass'`/`provenance:'scraped_promoted'`, and sets `riderReady:true` unconditionally) with a handler that re-measures the real candidate geometry, re-runs the canonical gate, and only promotes genuinely passing geometry while preserving actual provenance.

**Success state:** Approving a REVIEW route whose real candidate geometry fails the gate leaves it in REVIEW with riderReady=false; approving one whose real geometry passes promotes it with its true provenance and a real passing verdict; the decision is auditable in curation_artifacts.

## OUTCOME

A canonical `requireOperator(ctx)` guard backed by a stored `operator_roles` allowlist table rejects a seeded non-operator authenticated user with `FORBIDDEN` from every guarded trust-changing mutation while no state is mutated; a seeded operator passes; unauthenticated callers still fail with `UNAUTHENTICATED`.

## 🚫 CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS (Never tier — read before acting)

**MUST**
- MUST read convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md before implementation
- MUST back operator authorization with stored data (a queryable operator_roles table keyed by clerkUserId), never an env-var/config-only check, so a seeded non-operator user is rejected deterministically in an integration test
- MUST reuse requireIdentity inside requireOperator so an unauthenticated caller still fails with UNAUTHENTICATED before the role lookup, and a role-less authenticated caller fails with FORBIDDEN

**NEVER**
- NEVER allow a valid-but-non-operator authenticated identity to pass requireOperator — this is the load-bearing security property and the mandatory negative control
- NEVER expose a public unauthenticated/self-serve mutation that grants operator role to arbitrary callers; the operator bootstrap must be gated by a server-owned secret (env OPERATOR_BOOTSTRAP_KEY, following the DEV_AUTH_BYPASS_KEY pattern already in guards.ts:70-78) or an existing operator
- NEVER weaken or remove requireIdentity; requireOperator is strictly additive on top of it

**STRICTLY**
- STRICTLY apply requireOperator to every couch/review operational mutation cited in the red-hat review that is in this task's write scope: recordCouchVerdict, clearCouchVerdicts, couchGateStatus, runAllWaterfall, retireDisposition, prepareRetryDisposition
- STRICTLY schema changes are additive only (new operator_roles table + new index); no field removals or type narrowing on existing tables

## DONE WHEN

- AC-1 [Non-operator authenticated caller is rejected from a trust-changing couch mutation] [PRIMARY]: A seeded non-operator identity is rejected with FORBIDDEN from recordCouchVerdict
- AC-2 [Seeded operator passes the guard and the guarded mutation succeeds]: A seeded operator passes requireOperator and recordCouchVerdict succeeds
- AC-3 [Unauthenticated caller is rejected before the role lookup]: An unauthenticated call throws UNAUTHENTICATED, not FORBIDDEN
- AC-4 [Evidence-erasing mutation clearCouchVerdicts is operator-gated and preserves rows for non-operators]: A non-operator clearCouchVerdicts call is rejected and existing rows survive

## SPECIFICATION

**Objective:** Introduce a canonical server-owned founder/operator authorization primitive `requireOperator(ctx)` backed by a stored `operator_roles` allowlist table, and apply it to the trust-changing couch/review mutations that today rely only on existence-check `requireIdentity`.

**Success state:** A seeded non-operator authenticated user is rejected with FORBIDDEN from every guarded trust-changing mutation while no state is mutated; a seeded operator passes; unauthenticated callers still fail with UNAUTHENTICATED; the guard is a single reusable function other REDHAT-FIX tasks import.

`determineGateVerdict` (the canonical path every lever's NEW geometry goes through) enforces the same ≥2-in-region-anchor test that `reevaluateExistingGeometry` already has, so off-region anchors can no longer pass with a merely-sufficient raw anchor count.

**STRICTLY**

# REDHAT-FIX-08 — Remove or founder/operator-gate public fixture and cleanup seams so authenticated callers cannot manufacture or erase production trust evidence (UC-VER-04)
> Status: ⬜ Pending

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| TASK_ID | REDHAT-FIX-08 |
| SPRINT | [Sprint 04 — Trust pipeline](./SPRINT.md) |
| TASK_TYPE | FEATURE |

| TDD_MODE | `red_first` |
| RED_GREEN_REQUIRED | yes |
| CAPABILITIES | CAP-GEO-05 |
| DEPENDS_ON | REDHAT-FIX-06 |
| BLOCKS | REDHAT-FIX-01 |

RUNTIME_COMMANDS:
- test: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX08-*.integration.test.ts`
- typecheck: `npx tsc --noEmit -p convex/tsconfig.json`
- lint: `pnpm exec biome check`

> **Command note:** `pnpm test` maps to bare `vitest` (watch mode) and HANGS in an agent shell — always use `npx vitest run`. vitest has no `--grep`; the single-test filter is `-t '<name>'`.

## OUTCOME

Every public fixture/cleanup mutation that can manufacture or erase trust evidence (REVIEW seeds, couch seeds/teardown, waterfall seeds/teardown, couch-verdict clear) fails closed for an ordinary authenticated caller, while the legitimate internal/operator/test-env seeding path used by other REDHAT-FIX and existing S4 tests keeps working.

## 🚫 CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS (Never tier — read before acting)

**MUST**
- MUST read convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md before implementation
- MUST make every fixture/cleanup seam fail-closed for an ordinary authenticated production caller: seedReviewQueueEntry (convex/reviewQueue.ts:96), seedCouchFixtures + teardownCouchFixtures (convex/couchSampleAssembler.ts:356,370), seedWaterfallFixtures + seedPassedSampleRoutes + seedCostBurnRoutes + teardownWaterfallFixtures (convex/waterfallOrchestrator.ts:249,284,342,367), clearCouchVerdicts (convex/couchVerdict.ts:157)
- MUST convert these seams to internalMutation (unreachable from any public client) OR gate them behind a single requireFixtureAccess(ctx) guard that requires BOTH test-environment (isTestEnvironment) AND operator capability (requireOperator from REDHAT-FIX-06) AND server-issued run scoping
- MUST keep the legitimate test/operator path functional so REDHAT-FIX-09 and existing S4 integration tests can still seed via server-side/internal dispatch

**NEVER**
- NEVER leave a fixture or cleanup mutation callable by requireIdentity alone (existence check with no role/environment decision)
- NEVER allow clearCouchVerdicts or teardownCouchFixtures to delete couch_verdicts / couch_samples / curated_routes rows when invoked by an ordinary authenticated public caller
- NEVER allow seedReviewQueueEntry to insert production-shaped curated_routes / curated_route_geometry rows from a public client

**STRICTLY**
- STRICTLY fail-closed: absence of operator capability or non-test environment denies the seam (deny by default), never a silent no-op that returns success
- STRICTLY preserve real provider/trust records untouched when a denied call is attempted (zero rows created or deleted on denial)

## DONE WHEN

- AC-1 [Ordinary authenticated caller cannot manufacture REVIEW/couch trust evidence via the fixture seams] [PRIMARY]: seedReviewQueueEntry called by an ordinary caller creates zero curated_routes rows for the forged routeId
- AC-2 [Ordinary authenticated caller cannot erase existing couch trust evidence]: clearCouchVerdicts / teardownCouchFixtures called by an ordinary caller leaves rows intact
- AC-3 [Legitimate internal/operator path still seeds fixtures]: seedWaterfallFixtures via the legitimate dispatch still creates its rows
- AC-4 [Non-operator caller on the operator-gated entry is denied with FORBIDDEN]: A non-operator gets FORBIDDEN with zero row-count delta
- Every behavioral AC scenario passes `validate_scenario` (exit 0); RED-against-start recorded before GREEN; seeded-value EVIDENCE artifact captured
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p convex/tsconfig.json` → 0 errors + `pnpm exec biome check` clean + `pnpm convex:dev --once` clean
- NO-REGRESSION: `pnpm type-check` reports zero new errors vs. a baseline captured at task start
- Only SCOPE.writeAllowed files modified (`git diff --name-only`)

## SPECIFICATION

**Objective:** Lock down the eight public fixture/cleanup seams that can manufacture or erase trust evidence by converting them to internalMutation and/or routing them through a single requireFixtureAccess guard (test-environment + operator capability + server-issued run scope), so an authenticated ordinary production caller can neither seed nor delete trust-bearing rows.

**Success state:** An ordinary authenticated public caller invoking any of the eight seams is rejected with zero state change; the same operations remain available to the internal/operator/test path used by legitimate seeding; couch verdicts, couch samples, review-queue rows, and waterfall fixtures cannot be manufactured or erased from a public client.

## FIXTURES (shared seed data — referenced by scenario `start_ref`)

- `existing-couch-verdict-evidence` (seed_method: `public_api`): A real couch sample + passing couch verdict created through the legitimate operator/internal seeding path
    - `couch_samples 'couch-redhat08' + couch_verdicts pass`
- `authenticated-ordinary-identity` (seed_method: `public_api`): A real authenticated but non-operator identity simulating an ordinary production user
    - identity subject 'user_ordinary_redhat08' with no operator capability
- `review-queue-seed-attempt` (seed_method: `public_api`): A candidate routeId + geometry payload an ordinary caller would try to push into REVIEW
    - routeId 'test:redhat08-forge', bestCandidateGeometry (valid polyline)

## ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (TDD beads — RED → GREEN → REFACTOR per AC)

### AC-1 [PRIMARY] — Ordinary authenticated caller cannot manufacture REVIEW/couch trust evidence via the fixture seams

**Requirement:** GIVEN an authenticated non-operator identity against a non-test (production-shaped) deployment context WHEN the caller invokes seedReviewQueueEntry (and seedCouchFixtures) with a valid payload THEN the call is rejected fail-closed and zero curated_routes / curated_route_geometry / couch_samples rows are created for the forged routeId

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment (real mutations + requireFixtureAccess guard)
- FLOW_REF: UC-VER-04
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX08-fixture-lockdown.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: the seam still guards with a requireIdentity-only stub (ordinary caller succeeds and rows appear); operator check is mocked to always allow
- EVIDENCE: `db_query` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `review-queue-seed-attempt`
  - ACTION: Authenticate as authenticated-ordinary-identity; attempt seedReviewQueueEntry with a valid payload in a non-test context; query curated_routes and curation_artifacts by routeId 'test:redhat08-forge'
  - MUST_OBSERVE: the call throws error.code == 'FORBIDDEN'
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: curated_routes count for routeId 'test:redhat08-forge' > 0; a review_candidate curation_artifact is present for 'test:redhat08-forge'

### AC-2 — Ordinary authenticated caller cannot erase existing couch trust evidence

**Requirement:** GIVEN a pre-existing passing couch verdict and couch sample created by the legitimate path, and an authenticated non-operator identity in a non-test context WHEN the caller invokes clearCouchVerdicts and teardownCouchFixtures THEN the call is rejected fail-closed and the couch_verdicts / couch_samples rows remain intact

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment (real mutations + guard)
- FLOW_REF: UC-VER-04
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX08-fixture-lockdown.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: clearCouchVerdicts still deletes with a requireIdentity-only stub (verdict count drops to 0); teardownCouchFixtures still drops couch- prefixed samples for an ordinary caller
- EVIDENCE: `db_query` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `existing-couch-verdict-evidence`
  - ACTION: Seed existing-couch-verdict-evidence; authenticate as authenticated-ordinary-identity; attempt clearCouchVerdicts() and teardownCouchFixtures(); re-query couch_verdicts and couch_samples
  - MUST_OBSERVE: both calls throw error.code == 'FORBIDDEN'; couch_verdicts count for sample 'couch-redhat08' == 1 (unchanged)
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: couch_verdicts count == 0 after the attempt; couch_samples row 'couch-redhat08' is absent

### AC-3 — Legitimate internal/operator path still seeds fixtures (capability preserved, not merely deleted)

**Requirement:** GIVEN the server-side internal/operator dispatch path in the test environment WHEN seedWaterfallFixtures (or the internal equivalent) is invoked through the legitimate path THEN the fixture rows are created successfully, proving the lockdown denies only the public/ordinary path

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment (internal dispatch / operator path)
- FLOW_REF: UC-VER-04
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX08-fixture-lockdown.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: the seam was deleted outright so no seeding path remains (fixture rows never appear, absent); the internal path also throws so legitimate seeding is broken
- EVIDENCE: `db_query` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `authenticated-ordinary-identity`
  - ACTION: Invoke seedWaterfallFixtures via the legitimate internal/operator dispatch; query curated_routes for the three seeded waterfall routeIds
  - MUST_OBSERVE: curated_routes count for the three seeded waterfall routeIds == 3
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: curated_routes count for the seeded routeIds == 0

### AC-4 — Non-operator caller on the operator-gated entry is denied with FORBIDDEN

**Requirement:** GIVEN the requireFixtureAccess guard active and an authenticated non-operator identity in the test environment WHEN the non-operator invokes any seam that is gated by requireOperator rather than internalMutation-only THEN the guard throws a FORBIDDEN error and no state change occurs

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment (requireFixtureAccess + requireOperator)
- FLOW_REF: UC-VER-04
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX08-fixture-lockdown.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: requireOperator returns true for any authenticated identity (a stub); the FORBIDDEN error is caught and swallowed so the seam proceeds
- EVIDENCE: `api_response` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `authenticated-ordinary-identity`
  - ACTION: Authenticate as authenticated-ordinary-identity in test env; invoke the operator-gated fixture entry; capture the thrown error code and re-query the target table for row-count delta
  - MUST_OBSERVE: error.code == 'FORBIDDEN'; target table row-count delta == 0
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: the call succeeded for a non-operator (a row is present where none should be); target table row-count delta is empty/unmeasured

| TC-5 | The operator-gated fixture entry throws a FORBIDDEN error for a non-operator authenticated identity with zero row-count delta | AC-4 | `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX08-fixture-lockdown.integration.test.ts -t 'TC-5'` |

# REDHAT-FIX-08 — Remove or founder/operator-gate public fixture and cleanup seams so authenticated callers cannot manufacture or erase production trust evidence (UC-VER-04)
> Status: ⬜ Pending

| RED_GREEN_REQUIRED | yes |
| CAPABILITIES | CAP-GEO-05 |
| DEPENDS_ON | REDHAT-FIX-06 |
| BLOCKS | REDHAT-FIX-01 |

RUNTIME_COMMANDS:
- test: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX08-*.integration.test.ts`
- typecheck: `npx tsc --noEmit -p convex/tsconfig.json`
- lint: `pnpm exec biome check`

> **Command note:** `pnpm test` maps to bare `vitest` (watch mode) and HANGS in an agent shell — always use `npx vitest run`. vitest has no `--grep`; the single-test filter is `-t '<name>'`.

## OUTCOME

Every public fixture/cleanup mutation that can manufacture or erase trust evidence (REVIEW seeds, couch seeds/teardown, waterfall seeds/teardown, couch-verdict clear) fails closed for an ordinary authenticated caller, while the legitimate internal/operator/test-env seeding path used by other REDHAT-FIX and existing S4 tests keeps working.

## 🚫 CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS (Never tier — read before acting)

**MUST**
- MUST read convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md before implementation
- MUST make every fixture/cleanup seam fail-closed for an ordinary authenticated production caller: seedReviewQueueEntry (convex/reviewQueue.ts:96), seedCouchFixtures + teardownCouchFixtures (convex/couchSampleAssembler.ts:356,370), seedWaterfallFixtures + seedPassedSampleRoutes + seedCostBurnRoutes + teardownWaterfallFixtures (convex/waterfallOrchestrator.ts:249,284,342,367), clearCouchVerdicts (convex/couchVerdict.ts:157)
- MUST convert these seams to internalMutation (unreachable from any public client) OR gate them behind a single requireFixtureAccess(ctx) guard that requires BOTH test-environment (isTestEnvironment) AND operator capability (requireOperator from REDHAT-FIX-06) AND server-issued run scoping
- MUST keep the legitimate test/operator path functional so REDHAT-FIX-09 and existing S4 integration tests can still seed via server-side/internal dispatch

**NEVER**
- NEVER leave a fixture or cleanup mutation callable by requireIdentity alone (existence check with no role/environment decision)
- NEVER allow clearCouchVerdicts or teardownCouchFixtures to delete couch_verdicts / couch_samples / curated_routes rows when invoked by an ordinary authenticated public caller
- NEVER allow seedReviewQueueEntry to insert production-shaped curated_routes / curated_route_geometry rows from a public client

**STRICTLY**
- STRICTLY fail-closed: absence of operator capability or non-test environment denies the seam (deny by default), never a silent no-op that returns success
- STRICTLY preserve real provider/trust records untouched when a denied call is attempted (zero rows created or deleted on denial)

## DONE WHEN

- AC-1 [Ordinary authenticated caller cannot manufacture REVIEW/couch trust evidence via the fixture seams] [PRIMARY]: seedReviewQueueEntry called by an ordinary caller creates zero curated_routes rows for the forged routeId
- AC-2 [Ordinary authenticated caller cannot erase existing couch trust evidence]: clearCouchVerdicts / teardownCouchFixtures called by an ordinary caller leaves rows intact
- AC-3 [Legitimate internal/operator path still seeds fixtures]: seedWaterfallFixtures via the legitimate dispatch still creates its rows
- AC-4 [Non-operator caller on the operator-gated entry is denied with FORBIDDEN]: A non-operator gets FORBIDDEN with zero row-count delta
- Every behavioral AC scenario passes `validate_scenario` (exit 0); RED-against-start recorded before GREEN; seeded-value EVIDENCE artifact captured
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p convex/tsconfig.json` → 0 errors + `pnpm exec biome check` clean + `pnpm convex:dev --once` clean
- NO-REGRESSION: `pnpm type-check` reports zero new errors vs. a baseline captured at task start
- Only SCOPE.writeAllowed files modified (`git diff --name-only`)

## SPECIFICATION

**Objective:** Lock down the eight public fixture/cleanup seams that can manufacture or erase trust evidence by converting them to internalMutation and/or routing them through a single requireFixtureAccess guard (test-environment + operator capability + server-issued run scope), so an authenticated ordinary production caller can neither seed nor delete trust-bearing rows.

**Success state:** An ordinary authenticated public caller invoking any of the eight seams is rejected with zero state change; the same operations remain available to the internal/operator/test path used by legitimate seeding; couch verdicts, couch samples, review-queue rows, and waterfall fixtures cannot be manufactured or erased from a public client.

## FIXTURES (shared seed data — referenced by scenario `start_ref`)

- `existing-couch-verdict-evidence` (seed_method: `public_api`): A real couch sample + passing couch verdict created through the legitimate operator/internal seeding path
    - `couch_samples 'couch-redhat08' + couch_verdicts pass`
- `authenticated-ordinary-identity` (seed_method: `public_api`): A real authenticated but non-operator identity simulating an ordinary production user
    - identity subject 'user_ordinary_redhat08' with no operator capability
- `review-queue-seed-attempt` (seed_method: `public_api`): A candidate routeId + geometry payload an ordinary caller would try to push into REVIEW
    - routeId 'test:redhat08-forge', bestCandidateGeometry (valid polyline)

## ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (TDD beads — RED → GREEN → REFACTOR per AC)

### AC-1 [PRIMARY] — Ordinary authenticated caller cannot manufacture REVIEW/couch trust evidence via the fixture seams

**Requirement:** GIVEN an authenticated non-operator identity against a non-test (production-shaped) deployment context WHEN the caller invokes seedReviewQueueEntry (and seedCouchFixtures) with a valid payload THEN the call is rejected fail-closed and zero curated_routes / curated_route_geometry / couch_samples rows are created for the forged routeId

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment (real mutations + requireFixtureAccess guard)
- FLOW_REF: UC-VER-04
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX08-fixture-lockdown.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: the seam still guards with a requireIdentity-only stub (ordinary caller succeeds and rows appear); operator check is mocked to always allow
- EVIDENCE: `db_query` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `review-queue-seed-attempt`
  - ACTION: Authenticate as authenticated-ordinary-identity; attempt seedReviewQueueEntry with a valid payload in a non-test context; query curated_routes and curation_artifacts by routeId 'test:redhat08-forge'
  - MUST_OBSERVE: the call throws error.code == 'FORBIDDEN'
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: curated_routes count for routeId 'test:redhat08-forge' > 0; a review_candidate curation_artifact is present for 'test:redhat08-forge'

### AC-2 — Ordinary authenticated caller cannot erase existing couch trust evidence

**Requirement:** GIVEN a pre-existing passing couch verdict and couch sample created by the legitimate path, and an authenticated non-operator identity in a non-test context WHEN the caller invokes clearCouchVerdicts and teardownCouchFixtures THEN the call is rejected fail-closed and the couch_verdicts / couch_samples rows remain intact

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment (real mutations + guard)
- FLOW_REF: UC-VER-04
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX08-fixture-lockdown.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: clearCouchVerdicts still deletes with a requireIdentity-only stub (verdict count drops to 0); teardownCouchFixtures still drops couch- prefixed samples for an ordinary caller
- EVIDENCE: `db_query` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `existing-couch-verdict-evidence`
  - ACTION: Seed existing-couch-verdict-evidence; authenticate as authenticated-ordinary-identity; attempt clearCouchVerdicts() and teardownCouchFixtures(); re-query couch_verdicts and couch_samples
  - MUST_OBSERVE: both calls throw error.code == 'FORBIDDEN'; couch_verdicts count for sample 'couch-redhat08' == 1 (unchanged)
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: couch_verdicts count == 0 after the attempt; couch_samples row 'couch-redhat08' is absent

### AC-3 — Legitimate internal/operator path still seeds fixtures (capability preserved, not merely deleted)

**Requirement:** GIVEN the server-side internal/operator dispatch path in the test environment WHEN seedWaterfallFixtures (or the internal equivalent) is invoked through the legitimate path THEN the fixture rows are created successfully, proving the lockdown denies only the public/ordinary path

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment (internal dispatch / operator path)
- FLOW_REF: UC-VER-04

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: the seam was deleted outright so no seeding path remains (fixture rows never appear, absent); the internal path also throws so legitimate seeding is broken
- EVIDENCE: `db_query` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `authenticated-ordinary-identity`
  - ACTION: Invoke seedWaterfallFixtures via the legitimate internal/operator dispatch; query curated_routes for the three seeded waterfall routeIds
  - MUST_OBSERVE: curated_routes count for the three seeded waterfall routeIds == 3
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: curated_routes count for the seeded routeIds == 0

### AC-4 — Non-operator caller on the operator-gated entry is denied with FORBIDDEN

**Requirement:** GIVEN the requireFixtureAccess guard active and an authenticated non-operator identity in the test environment WHEN the non-operator invokes any seam that is gated by requireOperator rather than internalMutation-only THEN the guard throws a FORBIDDEN error and no state change occurs

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment (requireFixtureAccess + requireOperator)
- FLOW_REF: UC-VER-04
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX08-fixture-lockdown.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: requireOperator returns true for any authenticated identity (a stub); the FORBIDDEN error is caught and swallowed so the seam proceeds
- EVIDENCE: `api_response` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `authenticated-ordinary-identity`
  - ACTION: Authenticate as authenticated-ordinary-identity in test env; invoke the operator-gated fixture entry; capture the thrown error code and re-query the target table for row-count delta
  - MUST_OBSERVE: error.code == 'FORBIDDEN'; target table row-count delta == 0
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: the call succeeded for a non-operator (a row is present where none should be); target table row-count delta is empty/unmeasured

# REDHAT-FIX-09 — Make waterfall terminal-state, retry, and provider-cost accounting durable and fail-closed across Lever 3 exceptions and cost limits (UC-REC-04)
> Status: ⬜ Pending

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| TASK_ID | REDHAT-FIX-09 |
| SPRINT | [Sprint 04 — Trust pipeline](./SPRINT.md) |
| TASK_TYPE | FEATURE |
| AGENT | implementer=`convex-implementer` · reviewer=`convex-reviewer` |
| ESTIMATE | 120 min |
| EFFORT | M |
| PRIORITY | P0 |
| STATUS | Backlog |
| PROPOSED_BY | `convex-planner` |
| TDD_MODE | `red_first` |
| RED_GREEN_REQUIRED | yes |
| CAPABILITIES | CAP-GEO-06 |
| DEPENDS_ON | — |
| BLOCKS | REDHAT-FIX-01 |

RUNTIME_COMMANDS:
- test: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX09-*.integration.test.ts`
- typecheck: `npx tsc --noEmit -p convex/tsconfig.json`
- lint: `pnpm exec biome check`

> **Command note:** `pnpm test` maps to bare `vitest` (watch mode) and HANGS in an agent shell — always use `npx vitest run`. vitest has no `--grep`; the single-test filter is `-t '<name>'`.

## OUTCOME

Every route processed by `runSampleWaterfall` ends with exactly one authoritative terminal state (`recovered | queued | retirement_eligible | cost_blocked`); a Lever 2 attempt that reaches the provider and throws still records its cost; a cost-limited route is durably paused and reprocessed on resume.

## 🚫 CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS (Never tier — read before acting)

**MUST**
- MUST read convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md before implementation
- MUST persist exactly ONE authoritative terminal state per route in a durable single-source-of-truth store (a route_terminal_state table keyed by routeId with a unique-by-routeId index, upserted), so a route can never simultaneously hold 'retirement_eligible' and 'review_candidate' as its authoritative state — curation_artifacts remains an append-only audit log but is NOT the source of truth for terminal state
- MUST reserve/reconcile billable provider cost around the ACTUAL Lever 2 provider call, not only around success — a Lever 2 attempt that reaches the provider and then throws (waterfallOrchestrator.ts:638 catch) MUST still record its cost, which today only increments at :606-607 after success
- MUST represent a circuit-breaker pause explicitly and durably: when maxCost forces a break before Lever 2 (:554-560), the un-processed route MUST get a durable 'cost_blocked'/paused terminal state so a resume run reprocesses it rather than silently dropping it

**NEVER**
- NEVER write two conflicting authoritative terminal states for one route (the :701-719 catch that records both a retirement_eligible terminal artifact AND a review_candidate artifact must resolve to a single authoritative state)
- NEVER let a billable provider attempt complete without its cost reflected in totalCostUsd
- NEVER leave a route touched by the batch (Lever 1 ran) without a durable terminal or paused state when the batch stops on cost

**STRICTLY**
- STRICTLY fail-closed: an exception on any lever resolves to a single explicit durable terminal state, never an ambiguous or absent one
- STRICTLY keep the Lever 3 review-candidate geometry as evidence WITHOUT it becoming a second authoritative terminal state

## DONE WHEN

- AC-1 [A Lever 3 exception yields exactly one authoritative terminal state per route] [PRIMARY]: A route where L3 throws has exactly 1 route_terminal_state row, terminalState='retirement_eligible'
- AC-2 [A billable Lever 2 provider attempt that throws still records its cost]: A billable-then-throw L2 attempt yields totalCostUsd >= costPerReconstruct
- AC-3 [A cost-limited route is durably paused and reprocessed on resume]: A route left unprocessed by a cost break is durably 'cost_blocked' and reprocessed on resume
- AC-4 [Across a full mixed batch every route has exactly one authoritative terminal state]: Every route in a mixed batch has exactly 1 route_terminal_state row
- Every behavioral AC scenario passes `validate_scenario` (exit 0); RED-against-start recorded before GREEN; seeded-value EVIDENCE artifact captured
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p convex/tsconfig.json` → 0 errors + `pnpm exec biome check` clean + `pnpm convex:dev --once` clean
- NO-REGRESSION: `pnpm type-check` reports zero new errors vs. a baseline captured at task start
- Only SCOPE.writeAllowed files modified (`git diff --name-only`)

## SPECIFICATION

**Objective:** Replace the dueling append-only artifact model with a durable single-authoritative-terminal-state-per-route store, reconcile provider cost around the actual Lever 2 call (charge on attempt, not only success), and make circuit-breaker pauses explicit and resumable.

**Success state:** Every route processed by runSampleWaterfall ends with exactly one authoritative terminal state (recovered | queued | retirement_eligible | cost_blocked); a Lever 2 attempt that reaches the provider and throws still records its cost; a cost-limited route is durably paused and reprocessed on resume; a Lever 3 exception yields one authoritative state, not a retirement_eligible + review_candidate pair.

## FIXTURES (shared seed data — referenced by scenario `start_ref`)

- `lever3-exception-route` (seed_method: `public_api`): A route seeded so Lever 1 and Lever 2 fail and Lever 3 (rerouteForRoute) throws
    - routeId `test:redhat09-l3-throws`
- `lever2-billable-then-throws` (seed_method: `recorded_external`): A route whose Lever 2 reconstruct reaches the Google Routes provider (billable) and then the downstream throws, recorded once
    - cassette `convex/__tests__/fixtures/REDHATFIX09-l2-billable-throw.cassette.json`
- `cost-limit-paused-batch` (seed_method: `public_api`): Several unresolved cost-burn routes seeded so a maxCost budget forces a circuit-breaker break before Lever 2 on a later route
    - routeIds `test:redhat09-cost-000`..`-003`
- `mixed-terminal-batch` (seed_method: `public_api`): A batch of routes covering recovered, queued (REVIEW), and retirement_eligible outcomes
    - routeIds `test:lever1-pass`, `test:review-candidate`, `test:redhat09-l3-throws`

## ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (TDD beads — RED → GREEN → REFACTOR per AC)

### AC-1 [PRIMARY] — A Lever 3 exception yields exactly one authoritative terminal state per route

**Requirement:** GIVEN a route that fails Lever 1 and Lever 2 (with a best-candidate geometry captured) and throws in Lever 3 WHEN runSampleWaterfall processes the route and hits the Lever 3 catch THEN the durable route_terminal_state store has exactly one authoritative row for the route (terminalState is a single value, e.g. 'retirement_eligible'), never a coexisting 'review_candidate' authoritative state

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment (real runSampleWaterfall + route_terminal_state store)
- FLOW_REF: UC-REC-04
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX09-waterfall-terminal.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: the code writes both a retirement_eligible terminal artifact and a review_candidate artifact as authoritative state (unchanged dueling-artifact bug); the terminal store is a stub returning a fixed single value regardless of input
- EVIDENCE: `db_query` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `lever3-exception-route`
  - ACTION: Seed lever3-exception-route; call runSampleWaterfall({routeIds:['test:redhat09-l3-throws']}); query the durable route_terminal_state store
  - MUST_OBSERVE: route_terminal_state count for the routeId == 1; terminalState == 'retirement_eligible'
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: route_terminal_state count for the routeId == 2 (dueling states); no terminal_state row is present

### AC-2 — A billable Lever 2 provider attempt that throws still records its cost

**Requirement:** GIVEN a route whose Lever 2 reconstruct reaches the Google Routes provider (billable) and then throws, replayed from a recorded cassette WHEN runSampleWaterfall processes the route and the Lever 2 call throws after the provider exchange THEN the reported totalCostUsd (and the route's durable cost) includes the attempted call's cost

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Google Routes API v2 recorded-and-replayed + Convex dev deployment
- FLOW_REF: UC-REC-04
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX09-waterfall-cost.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: cost only increments after a successful l2Wrapped (unchanged success-only accounting) so a thrown attempt records a cost of 0 (empty); the provider call is mocked so no real billable exchange is replayed
- EVIDENCE: `api_response` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `lever2-billable-then-throws`
  - ACTION: Seed lever2-billable-then-throws with its recorded cassette; call runSampleWaterfall replaying the cassette so L2 is attempted then throws; read the returned WaterfallReport.totalCostUsd
  - MUST_OBSERVE: totalCostUsd >= 0.05
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: totalCostUsd == 0 after a billable attempt threw

### AC-3 — A cost-limited route is durably paused and reprocessed on resume

**Requirement:** GIVEN a batch of unresolved cost-burn routes and a maxCost that forces a circuit-breaker break before Lever 2 on a later route WHEN runSampleWaterfall stops on cost, then a resume run is invoked without the cost limit THEN the un-processed route carries a durable 'cost_blocked'/paused terminal state after the first run, and the resume run reprocesses it to a normal terminal state

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment (real runSampleWaterfall resume)
- FLOW_REF: UC-REC-04
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX09-waterfall-cost.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: the cost-limited route has no durable state after the break (the loop just breaks, leaving the row absent); the paused route is treated as already-recovered and skipped on resume
- EVIDENCE: `db_query` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `cost-limit-paused-batch`
  - ACTION: Seed cost-limit-paused-batch; call runSampleWaterfall with maxCost exhausted before the last route's Lever 2; query route_terminal_state for the un-processed route; call runSampleWaterfall again with no maxCost; re-query its terminal state
  - MUST_OBSERVE: terminalState after run 1 == 'cost_blocked'; batchStopReason == 'cost_exceeded'
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: route_terminal_state row for the un-processed route is absent after run 1; the paused route's terminalState == 'recovered' before resume

### AC-4 — Across a full mixed batch every route has exactly one authoritative terminal state (invariant)

**Requirement:** GIVEN a batch producing recovered, queued (REVIEW), and retirement_eligible outcomes WHEN runSampleWaterfall processes the batch THEN for every routeId, the durable route_terminal_state store holds exactly one authoritative row — no route holds two conflicting authoritative terminal states

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment (real runSampleWaterfall)
- FLOW_REF: UC-REC-04
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX09-waterfall-terminal.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: any route yields two authoritative terminal rows (unchanged dueling-state bug); the terminal store upsert is keyed by something other than routeId so duplicates accrue
- EVIDENCE: `db_query` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `mixed-terminal-batch`
  - ACTION: Seed mixed-terminal-batch; call runSampleWaterfall over the 3 routeIds; for each routeId count authoritative rows in route_terminal_state
  - MUST_OBSERVE: route_terminal_state count per routeId == 1 for all 3 routeIds
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: any routeId with route_terminal_state count >= 2; any routeId with route_terminal_state count == 0

## TEST CRITERIA

| TC-3 | A cost-limited un-processed route has terminalState='cost_blocked' after the break | AC-3 | `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX09-waterfall-cost.integration.test.ts -t 'TC-3'` |
| TC-4 | A resume run reprocesses a cost_blocked route to a normal terminal state | AC-3 | `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX09-waterfall-cost.integration.test.ts -t 'TC-4'` |
| TC-5 | Across a mixed batch each routeId has exactly one authoritative route_terminal_state row | AC-4 | `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX09-waterfall-terminal.integration.test.ts -t 'TC-5'` |

## SCOPE (file-level write permissions)

**writeAllowed:**
- convex/waterfallOrchestrator.ts (MODIFY — single terminal state, cost reconciliation, explicit pause)
- convex/schema.ts (MODIFY — ADD route_terminal_state table, additive only, unique-by-routeId index)

- Any RN/Expo file
- Hand-authoring or editing the AC-2 cassette (re-record by deleting the file and re-running against the live provider)
- Charging cost twice for a single provider attempt
- Removing existing curated_route_geometry side-table rows

## READING LIST

- `convex/waterfallOrchestrator.ts` (485-560) — Lever 1 runs unconditionally; cost check before L2 (:554-560) breaks the loop leaving the route with no durable terminal state
- `convex/waterfallOrchestrator.ts` (586-641) — cost increments at :606-607 ONLY after successful l2Wrapped; the :638 catch records no cost even after a billable provider attempt
- `convex/waterfallOrchestrator.ts` (695-720) — the Lever 3 catch writes BOTH recordTerminalArtifact(retirement_eligible) AND recordReviewArtifact(review_candidate) for the same route — the dueling-state bug
- `convex/waterfallOrchestrator.ts` (759-825) — recordTerminalArtifact/recordReviewArtifact write to curation_artifacts (append-only log), not a single-row-per-route terminal state

- Pattern: Durable single-authoritative-state-per-route via an upserted route_terminal_state table (unique by routeId); cost reserved around routeWithInvocationCount and reconciled on both success and throw; explicit 'cost_blocked' paused state checkpointed for resume

RUNTIME_COMMANDS:
- test: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX09-*.integration.test.ts`
- typecheck: `npx tsc --noEmit -p convex/tsconfig.json`
- lint: `pnpm exec biome check`

> **Command note:** `pnpm test` maps to bare `vitest` (watch mode) and HANGS in an agent shell — always use `npx vitest run`. vitest has no `--grep`; the single-test filter is `-t '<name>'`.

## OUTCOME

Every route processed by `runSampleWaterfall` ends with exactly one authoritative terminal state (`recovered | queued | retirement_eligible | cost_blocked`); a Lever 2 attempt that reaches the provider and throws still records its cost; a cost-limited route is durably paused and reprocessed on resume.

## 🚫 CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS (Never tier — read before acting)

**MUST**
- MUST read convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md before implementation
- MUST persist exactly ONE authoritative terminal state per route in a durable single-source-of-truth store (a route_terminal_state table keyed by routeId with a unique-by-routeId index, upserted), so a route can never simultaneously hold 'retirement_eligible' and 'review_candidate' as its authoritative state — curation_artifacts remains an append-only audit log but is NOT the source of truth for terminal state
- MUST reserve/reconcile billable provider cost around the ACTUAL Lever 2 provider call, not only around success — a Lever 2 attempt that reaches the provider and then throws (waterfallOrchestrator.ts:638 catch) MUST still record its cost, which today only increments at :606-607 after success
- MUST represent a circuit-breaker pause explicitly and durably: when maxCost forces a break before Lever 2 (:554-560), the un-processed route MUST get a durable 'cost_blocked'/paused terminal state so a resume run reprocesses it rather than silently dropping it

**NEVER**
- NEVER write two conflicting authoritative terminal states for one route (the :701-719 catch that records both a retirement_eligible terminal artifact AND a review_candidate artifact must resolve to a single authoritative state)
- NEVER let a billable provider attempt complete without its cost reflected in totalCostUsd
- NEVER leave a route touched by the batch (Lever 1 ran) without a durable terminal or paused state when the batch stops on cost

**STRICTLY**
- STRICTLY fail-closed: an exception on any lever resolves to a single explicit durable terminal state, never an ambiguous or absent one
- STRICTLY keep the Lever 3 review-candidate geometry as evidence WITHOUT it becoming a second authoritative terminal state

## DONE WHEN

- AC-1 [A Lever 3 exception yields exactly one authoritative terminal state per route] [PRIMARY]: A route where L3 throws has exactly 1 route_terminal_state row, terminalState='retirement_eligible'
- AC-2 [A billable Lever 2 provider attempt that throws still records its cost]: A billable-then-throw L2 attempt yields totalCostUsd >= costPerReconstruct
- AC-3 [A cost-limited route is durably paused and reprocessed on resume]: A route left unprocessed by a cost break is durably 'cost_blocked' and reprocessed on resume
- AC-4 [Across a full mixed batch every route has exactly one authoritative terminal state]: Every route in a mixed batch has exactly 1 route_terminal_state row
- Every behavioral AC scenario passes `validate_scenario` (exit 0); RED-against-start recorded before GREEN; seeded-value EVIDENCE artifact captured
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p convex/tsconfig.json` → 0 errors + `pnpm exec biome check` clean + `pnpm convex:dev --once` clean
- NO-REGRESSION: `pnpm type-check` reports zero new errors vs. a baseline captured at task start
- Only SCOPE.writeAllowed files modified (`git diff --name-only`)

## SPECIFICATION

**Objective:** Replace the dueling append-only artifact model with a durable single-authoritative-terminal-state-per-route store, reconcile provider cost around the actual Lever 2 call (charge on attempt, not only success), and make circuit-breaker pauses explicit and resumable.

**Success state:** Every route processed by runSampleWaterfall ends with exactly one authoritative terminal state (recovered | queued | retirement_eligible | cost_blocked); a Lever 2 attempt that reaches the provider and throws still records its cost; a cost-limited route is durably paused and reprocessed on resume; a Lever 3 exception yields one authoritative state, not a retirement_eligible + review_candidate pair.

## FIXTURES (shared seed data — referenced by scenario `start_ref`)

- `lever3-exception-route` (seed_method: `public_api`): A route seeded so Lever 1 and Lever 2 fail and Lever 3 (rerouteForRoute) throws
    - routeId `test:redhat09-l3-throws`
- `lever2-billable-then-throws` (seed_method: `recorded_external`): A route whose Lever 2 reconstruct reaches the Google Routes provider (billable) and then the downstream throws, recorded once
    - cassette `convex/__tests__/fixtures/REDHATFIX09-l2-billable-throw.cassette.json`
- `cost-limit-paused-batch` (seed_method: `public_api`): Several unresolved cost-burn routes seeded so a maxCost budget forces a circuit-breaker break before Lever 2 on a later route
    - routeIds `test:redhat09-cost-000`..`-003`
- `mixed-terminal-batch` (seed_method: `public_api`): A batch of routes covering recovered, queued (REVIEW), and retirement_eligible outcomes
    - routeIds `test:lever1-pass`, `test:review-candidate`, `test:redhat09-l3-throws`

## ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (TDD beads — RED → GREEN → REFACTOR per AC)

### AC-1 [PRIMARY] — A Lever 3 exception yields exactly one authoritative terminal state per route

**Requirement:** GIVEN a route that fails Lever 1 and Lever 2 (with a best-candidate geometry captured) and throws in Lever 3 WHEN runSampleWaterfall processes the route and hits the Lever 3 catch THEN the durable route_terminal_state store has exactly one authoritative row for the route (terminalState is a single value, e.g. 'retirement_eligible'), never a coexisting 'review_candidate' authoritative state

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment (real runSampleWaterfall + route_terminal_state store)
- FLOW_REF: UC-REC-04
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX09-waterfall-terminal.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: the code writes both a retirement_eligible terminal artifact and a review_candidate artifact as authoritative state (unchanged dueling-artifact bug); the terminal store is a stub returning a fixed single value regardless of input
- EVIDENCE: `db_query` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `lever3-exception-route`
  - ACTION: Seed lever3-exception-route; call runSampleWaterfall({routeIds:['test:redhat09-l3-throws']}); query the durable route_terminal_state store
  - MUST_OBSERVE: route_terminal_state count for the routeId == 1; terminalState == 'retirement_eligible'
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: route_terminal_state count for the routeId == 2 (dueling states); no terminal_state row is present

### AC-2 — A billable Lever 2 provider attempt that throws still records its cost

**Requirement:** GIVEN a route whose Lever 2 reconstruct reaches the Google Routes provider (billable) and then throws, replayed from a recorded cassette WHEN runSampleWaterfall processes the route and the Lever 2 call throws after the provider exchange THEN the reported totalCostUsd (and the route's durable cost) includes the attempted call's cost

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Google Routes API v2 recorded-and-replayed + Convex dev deployment
- FLOW_REF: UC-REC-04
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX09-waterfall-cost.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: cost only increments after a successful l2Wrapped (unchanged success-only accounting) so a thrown attempt records a cost of 0 (empty); the provider call is mocked so no real billable exchange is replayed
- EVIDENCE: `api_response` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `lever2-billable-then-throws`
  - ACTION: Seed lever2-billable-then-throws with its recorded cassette; call runSampleWaterfall replaying the cassette so L2 is attempted then throws; read the returned WaterfallReport.totalCostUsd
  - MUST_OBSERVE: totalCostUsd >= 0.05
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: totalCostUsd == 0 after a billable attempt threw

### AC-3 — A cost-limited route is durably paused and reprocessed on resume

**Requirement:** GIVEN a batch of unresolved cost-burn routes and a maxCost that forces a circuit-breaker break before Lever 2 on a later route WHEN runSampleWaterfall stops on cost, then a resume run is invoked without the cost limit THEN the un-processed route carries a durable 'cost_blocked'/paused terminal state after the first run, and the resume run reprocesses it to a normal terminal state

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment (real runSampleWaterfall resume)
- FLOW_REF: UC-REC-04
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX09-waterfall-cost.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: the cost-limited route has no durable state after the break (the loop just breaks, leaving the row absent); the paused route is treated as already-recovered and skipped on resume
- EVIDENCE: `db_query` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `cost-limit-paused-batch`
  - ACTION: Seed cost-limit-paused-batch; call runSampleWaterfall with maxCost exhausted before the last route's Lever 2; query route_terminal_state for the un-processed route; call runSampleWaterfall again with no maxCost; re-query its terminal state
  - MUST_OBSERVE: terminalState after run 1 == 'cost_blocked'; batchStopReason == 'cost_exceeded'
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: route_terminal_state row for the un-processed route is absent after run 1; the paused route's terminalState == 'recovered' before resume

### AC-4 — Across a full mixed batch every route has exactly one authoritative terminal state (invariant)

**Requirement:** GIVEN a batch producing recovered, queued (REVIEW), and retirement_eligible outcomes WHEN runSampleWaterfall processes the batch THEN for every routeId, the durable route_terminal_state store holds exactly one authoritative row — no route holds two conflicting authoritative terminal states

- TEST_TIER: `integration` · VERIFICATION_SERVICE: Convex dev deployment (real runSampleWaterfall)
- FLOW_REF: UC-REC-04
- VERIFY: `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX09-waterfall-terminal.integration.test.ts`

SCENARIO (validated by `tools/validate-scenario/validate_scenario.py` — exit 0):
- NEGATIVE_CONTROL — would fail if: any route yields two authoritative terminal rows (unchanged dueling-state bug); the terminal store upsert is keyed by something other than routeId so duplicates accrue
- EVIDENCE: `db_query` (required_capture: true)
- CASE 1 — start_ref `mixed-terminal-batch`
  - ACTION: Seed mixed-terminal-batch; call runSampleWaterfall over the 3 routeIds; for each routeId count authoritative rows in route_terminal_state
  - MUST_OBSERVE: route_terminal_state count per routeId == 1 for all 3 routeIds
  - MUST_NOT_OBSERVE: any routeId with route_terminal_state count >= 2; any routeId with route_terminal_state count == 0

| TC-2 | A billable Lever 2 attempt that throws yields totalCostUsd >= costPerReconstruct | AC-2 | `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX09-waterfall-cost.integration.test.ts -t 'TC-2'` |
| TC-3 | A cost-limited un-processed route has terminalState='cost_blocked' after the break | AC-3 | `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX09-waterfall-cost.integration.test.ts -t 'TC-3'` |
| TC-4 | A resume run reprocesses a cost_blocked route to a normal terminal state | AC-3 | `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX09-waterfall-cost.integration.test.ts -t 'TC-4'` |
| TC-5 | Across a mixed batch each routeId has exactly one authoritative route_terminal_state row | AC-4 | `npx vitest run convex/__tests__/REDHATFIX09-waterfall-terminal.integration.test.ts -t 'TC-5'` |

- `convex/waterfallOrchestrator.ts` (485-560) — Lever 1 runs unconditionally; cost check before L2 (:554-560) breaks the loop leaving the route with no durable terminal state
- `convex/waterfallOrchestrator.ts` (586-641) — cost increments at :606-607 ONLY after successful l2Wrapped; the :638 catch records no cost even after a billable provider attempt

- typecheck: `npx tsc --noEmit -p convex/tsconfig.json`

> **Command note:** `pnpm test` maps to bare `vitest` (watch mode) and HANGS in an agent shell — always use `npx vitest run`. vitest has no `--grep`; the single-test filter is `-t '<name>'`.

## OUTCOME

`storeCouchSample` assembles a couch_samples row solely from canonical curated_routes/curated_route_geometry records, rejects duplicate/nonexistent/non-gate-passing members, and freezes an immutable manifest under a deterministic server-derived hash.

## 🚫 CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS (Never tier — read before acting)

**MUST**
- MUST read convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md before implementation (project CLAUDE.md mandate)
- MUST derive EVERY stored member field (provenance, anchorCount, claimedMiles, routedMiles, difficulty, descriptionLength) from the canonical curated_routes / curated_route_geometry records looked up by routeId server-side — the caller supplies routeIds only, never metadata that is trusted verbatim
- MUST compute a server-derived manifestHash deterministically over the canonical membership set and persist it plus a frozen flag as ADDITIVE optional schema fields
- MUST reject a stored sample whose member's curated_route_geometry.verification.verdict is not 'pass'

**NEVER**
- NEVER store any client-asserted route metadata verbatim (the current storeCouchSample copies the caller's routes array unchecked)
- NEVER accept a routes set containing a duplicate routeId or a routeId absent from curated_routes
- NEVER mutate/replace a couch_samples row once frozen==true (append-only / immutable export)
- NEVER remove or narrow an existing couch_samples field — schema changes are additive-optional only

**STRICTLY**
- STRICTLY enforce sample size within COUCH_SAMPLE_MIN..COUCH_SAMPLE_MAX and at least one route of each of the three provenance types, preserving the existing size/stratification guarantees
- STRICTLY keep couch_verdict binding (sampleId→verdict) OUT of scope — that is REDHAT-FIX-03/04

## DONE WHEN

- AC-1 [Stored sample uses ONLY canonical member metadata, never client-asserted values] [PRIMARY]: A member's stored anchorCount/provenance/routedMiles are the DB values even when the caller asserts wrong ones
- AC-2 [Non-gate-passing member is rejected]: A member whose geometry verdict is 'review' throws MEMBER_NOT_GATE_PASSING
- AC-3 [Duplicate or nonexistent member routeId is rejected]: Duplicate → DUPLICATE_MEMBER; nonexistent → MEMBER_NOT_FOUND
- AC-4 [Frozen manifest is immutable — re-store of a frozen sampleId is rejected]: Re-storing a frozen sampleId throws SAMPLE_FROZEN and leaves the manifest unchanged
- AC-5 [manifestHash is deterministic over canonical membership and non-empty]: Identical membership stored in different order yields identical, non-empty manifestHash
- Every behavioral AC scenario passes `validate_scenario` (exit 0); RED-against-start recorded before GREEN; seeded-value EVIDENCE artifact captured
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p convex/tsconfig.json` → 0 errors + `pnpm exec biome check` clean + `pnpm convex:dev --once` clean
- NO-REGRESSION: `pnpm type-check` reports zero new errors vs. a baseline captured at task start
- Only SCOPE.writeAllowed files modified (`git diff --name-only`)

## SPECIFICATION

**Objective:** Rewrite storeCouchSample so a couch_samples row is a server-assembled, membership-validated, gate-passing, immutable manifest — accepting only a list of routeIds (or re-deriving all member metadata from canonical records regardless of what the caller sends), rejecting duplicates/nonexistent/non-gate-passing members, and freezing the manifest under a server-derived hash.

**Success state:** Every stored couch_samples row carries only canonical metadata sourced from curated_routes/curated_route_geometry, contains a unique membership set of gate-passing routes, and bears a deterministic manifestHash and frozen flag that make later re-writes impossible — so a downstream verdict/manifest binding (REDHAT-FIX-03/04) is anchored to an honest sample.

## FIXTURES (shared seed data — referenced by scenario `start_ref`)

- `canonical-couch-catalog` (seed_method: `public_api`): ~30 canonical curated_routes across all 3 provenance types, each with a passing curated_route_geometry.verification.verdict — seeded through the existing public seedCouchFixtures mutation

- `member-gate-failing` (seed_method: `public_api`): A canonical curated_routes row whose curated_route_geometry.verification.verdict='review' (gate-failing) — new seeder seedCouchFailingMember
    - routeId 'test:couch-failing-001', verification.verdict='review', failedCondition='ratio'
- `frozen-sample-preexisting` (seed_method: `public_api`): A couch_samples row already stored AND frozen — via storeCouchSample then freezeCouchSample
